title: Ryan OS Builder Profile
description: One file per builder in ryan-os/builder-library/profiles/. This is the authoritative record of what Ryan OS knows about a builder. Anything set here overrides the governed defaults in decision-engine/defaults.json.

builder_id.description: Stable slug. Never change it once real jobs reference it.

display_name.description: Exactly how the builder name should appear in the email subject and body.

status.description: flagged = do-not-bid / credit hold / open dispute. A flagged builder is a hard stop and escalates to Ryan.

flag_reason.description: Required when status is flagged. Shown to Ryan in the escalation notice.

builder_type.description: Drives the equipment default when no explicit standard configuration is set.

aliases.description: Every way this builder shows up in Outlook: legal name, DBA, email domain, superintendent shorthand. Matching is case-insensitive. Include the email domain (e.g. 'examplehomes.com') - domain matches are the most reliable signal.

gross_margin.description: Decimal, e.g. 0.22 for 22%. Overrides the governed default. This is where a production builder's contracted margin lives.

requires_ryan_margin_approval.description: true = hard stop. The turnover email is drafted but held for Ryan.

equipment.description: The builder's standard configuration. Overrides the production/custom default.

system.description: One-line description used in the email, e.g. 'Carrier 15.2 SEER2 single-speed heat pump'.

system_count_rule.description: Builder-specific override of the one-system-per-floor default, e.g. 'Single system up to 3200 sqft, two above'. Free text - the engine surfaces it to the estimator rather than parsing it.

name.description: e.g. 'City of San Marcos' or 'Hays County'

manual_j_overrides.description: Builder-standard envelope specs that beat the Ryan OS Manual J defaults. Any key from defaults.json manual_j_defaults.

options.description: Per-option control over the always-include list. Keys match defaults.json always_include keys.

exclude.description: Option keys this builder has told us to stop including. Excluding an item requires a reason in exclude_reasons.

additional.description: Extra options this builder always wants priced.

standing_instructions.description: Anything the estimating team must know every single time. Rendered verbatim in the email.

attachments_expected.description: What this builder normally sends, e.g. 'architectural PDF', 'plot plan', 'energy report'. Used to detect what is missing.

last_reviewed.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Review profiles at least annually.
